speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Brother? Gilbert. From St Bride's, and back since Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Brother. You are in. I am at the house.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I have been down on the shop's business. The buckets and the leather hooks hang filled by every well in Henley Street, as the bailiff ordered.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Filled. That is the order kept.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Anne's beans are a span high. Hamnet won twopence at the butts with blunt arrows. Our mother would know whether you eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I eat. Tell her so if she asks you, and not a sermon with it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Hobbins is in on Thursday. I cannot leave the shop. Will you fetch what's come.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: And the girl's day is the twenty-sixth.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: So had I, till the almanac told me.
